note: Both sets capture the main member sizes (L3x3x1/4 angle, 3" STD pipe, 4 1/2x4 1/2x1/2 plate, 3/4" bolts and holes, 1 1/2" hole, T.O. STEEL 11'-4"), but Set B introduces several unsupported bindings: a 'PV POST base plate edge distance' of 2", a weld size with an invented 'top connection' condition, a 'typical' condition and quote for T.O. STEEL that is not in the text, and a fabricated '1/4" TYP' typical dimension. Set A errs mainly in mislabeling the PL 3"X3/8"X1'-6" plate as an angle, inventing a 'CRANE ATTACHEMENT C3' entity for the 3" TYP dimension, and leaving two vague dimension claims (3/8", 2") with ambiguous quotes. Set A also covers plate thicknesses (1" TYP, 1/2" TYP, 3/8" PL TYP) and the C3 scale, while Set B uniquely captures the 4 X 3/8" cap plate, but Set B's invented property/condition bindings outweigh that gain.
